IncidentBot: PAGER - Severity: Sev2 - Region: eu-west-2 - elevated 5xx and traffic-shift failures detected. Auto-diagnostics started. Paging oncall: @Sara N., @Mike O.
Sara N.: I'm on it. seeing spike in 504/502 from ingress LB in eu-west-2. anyone started a traffic shift to eu-north-1?
Mike O.: I started a controlled traffic shift to eu-north-1 ~00:04 UTC ago, weight reached 40% but it got stuck at 40% and healthchecks are intermittently failing. Some requests still hitting eu-west-2 and timing out.
Juan P.: tailing logs now. I see backend connection errors when routed to eu-north-1, mostly upstream egress failures to redis/cache and some SNAT mismatch logs.
Sara N.: paste route-control status and a couple of ingress health logs?
Juan P.: route-control status for svc/api:
```
service: api
eu-west-2: 60
eu-north-1: 40 (pending)
state: stuck_on_healthcheck
```
Mike O.: from an internal bm-node in eu-north-1 curl to /health returns 200, but global LB probes show 502/504. Example from LB probe log:
```
2026-03-15T14:03:12Z LB-probe api.redwood.com "GET /health" 502 0.310s
```
IncidentBot: Auto-diagnostics: detected DNS/egress IP mismatch for eu-north-1 (expected 18.234.x.x, observed 18.234.y.y). Suggests regional egress routing instability during routeflip.
Priya K.: infra-networking and provider oncall, please assist. @Mike O. open provider P1 case. Also start a customer-impact list: who is on Dedicated in eu-west-2?
Mike O.: Opening cloud ticket now (provider case #123456). Immediate mitigation: scaling ingress in eu-west-2 and adding a temporary fallback route to us-east-1 (higher latency but reduces 5xx). Executing commands now.
Sara N.: I'm going to roll back the traffic shift to 100% eu-west-2 to stop split traffic until provider confirms egress stability. Mike, confirm when fallback route is active.
Mike O.: Fallback route to us-east-1 added via route-control; forcing sticky routing to eu-west-2. Rolling back shift: setting eu-north-1 weight -> 0.
Juan P.: healthchecks improving after rollback. 5xx rate dropping from 4.2% -> 0.3% over the last 3 minutes according to metrics.
Priya K.: good. Draft customer comms: short, clear, timeline + mitigation + next steps. Assign @Sara N. to send. Also prepare internal postmortem checklist.
Sara N.: drafting now. Will include timeline, what we changed, mitigation, and required actions (provider follow-up + canary test).
IncidentBot: On-call handoff scheduled in 45m. @Sara N. will hand off to @Juan P. at 14:30 UTC.
Juan P.: I'll take next oncall; I'll validate cross-region egress rules and run additional sweeps once load stabilizes.
Mike O.: Provider initial reply: "We observe asymmetric SNAT mapping on some hosts in eu-north-1 during routeflip; investigating." Case #123456.
Sara N.: status update: mitigation applied and services nominal. Immediate customer impact: 12 customers experienced elevated 5xx for ~7 minutes; top-2 Dedicated customers saw errors for ~12 minutes and had error budget impact. Will include exact affected tenant IDs in the incident doc.
Priya K.: owners: provider follow-up -> Mike O.; egress canary + monitoring -> Juan P.; customer comms -> Sara N.; postmortem -> Priya K.
IncidentBot: Incident state: Mitigated. Please confirm if any residual errors are observed.
Mike O.: metrics stable for 20m, error rates back to baseline. Moving to post-incident review channel (#postmortems).
Sara N.: sending customer emails now and attaching timeline/logs to the incident doc. Great job team :thumbsup:
Juan P.: note for postmortem: likely root cause is asymmetric NAT/SNAT mapping when shared egress IPs are reused during route flips. Recommend adding a synthetic canary that validates egress IP/routing after any route-control change.
Priya K.: creating JIRA tasks: INF-789 (provider follow-up), INF-790 (egress-canary test), INF-791 (postmortem and RCA).
Sara N.: initiating handoff to Juan. I'll be offline after 14:40 UTC. Leaving notes and logs in the incident doc.
Juan P.: acknowledged, taking over oncall at 14:30 UTC. I'll run the egress verification runbook and keep this thread updated if anything regresses.
IncidentBot: Handoff recorded: previous oncall Sara N. -> new oncall Juan P. at 14:30 UTC.
Juan P.: will close this thread for now and reopen if we see regressions. Thanks everyone.
